# online hub: the online menu opens, the account is signed in (profile present), then back to the main menu
# Generated by tools/console-1.2/gen_online.py (edit the generator, not this file). One console, the real online service, no opponent: MULTIPLAYER -> ONLINE -> RANKED MATCH opens Online Central (the login, the hub), dwell 10 s, Circle out
# Menus are driven by pad presses only; the public name comes from MSC_ONLINE_NAME in the run's np-player.txt (nothing is typed). Every screen logs a STATE line: a missing one is a TIMEOUT
# line of the script and the run is INVALID.
mash 100 20 scene == 0
log STATE title screen
mash 100 30 scene != 0
wait scene == 1 || scene == 10
wait scene == 10 || nbuttons >= 8
if scene == 10
log first run: no save file, accepting 'create save data'
wait nbuttons >= 2
idle 10
mash 100 30 scene == 1
wait nbuttons >= 8
endif
wait onctx == 0
log STATE main menu
idle 30
# The main menu is a ring picked by stick/D-pad angle; Multiplayer (ctx 1) is up-left.
hold 30 0 -80 80
wait onctx == 1 120
idle 10
log STATE pointer on multiplayer
idle 20
press 100
wait scene == 10 1200
log STATE multiplayer mode choice
wait nbuttons >= 3 900
idle 60
mash 8 15 onctx == 0 180
idle 10
press 100
log chose online
wait scene == 1 900
wait scene == 10 1200
wait nbuttons >= 3 900
log STATE online choice popup
idle 60
mash 4 15 onctx == 2 300
idle 10
press 100
log chose ranked
wait scene == 40 || scene == 10 3600
if scene == 10
log STATE first-time notice
idle 120
mash 100 40 scene != 10 1200
endif
wait scene == 40 3600
log STATE online hub
idle 300
log STATE hub read, leaving
# back out to the main menu: Circle leaves a scene one step at a time (player count -> hub -> main menu); a Circle that is not needed is not pressed
idle 60
if scene != 1
press 200
idle 180
endif
if scene != 1
press 200
idle 180
endif
if scene != 1
press 200
idle 180
endif
wait scene == 1 900
idle 60
log STATE back in the main menu
exit
